title: 1st Place – Techno Summit at Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology
desc: Secured 1st place at the Techno Summit hosted by Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology for presenting DiabEase, an AI-powered diabetes management platform featuring insulin dosage prediction, personalized diet recommendations, and real-time blood sugar alerts aimed at improving healthcare accessibility and patient support.

title: 1st Place – Project Expo 2K25 at St. Xavier’s Catholic College of Engineering.
desc: Secured 1st place at Project Expo 2K25 conducted by St. Xavier’s Catholic College of Engineering, Nagercoil, organized by IEEE Educational Society SBC - 62851 and IEEE Photonics Society - 62851. Presented DiabEase, an AI-powered personalized diabetes assistant designed to support intelligent diabetes management through predictive healthcare and real-time assistance systems.

title: 1st Place – CodeFrei AI National-Level Hackathon at St. Joseph’s College of Engineering
desc: Secured 1st place at CodeFrei AI, a 24-hour national-level AI hackathon hosted by St. Joseph’s College of Engineering. Led Team BDNA in developing an AI-powered Message Control Protocol (MCP) for Telegram Messenger focused on real-time moderation, spam filtering, phishing detection, hate speech control, and intelligent communication safety using AI-driven bots and NLP systems.

title: 2nd Place – AI AppXcelerate at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Ramapuram
desc: Secured 2nd place at AI AppXcelerate, an AI-focused competition organized by SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Ramapuram. Collaborated on developing an innovative AI-driven solution that demonstrated problem-solving, strategic planning, and real-world application development in a highly competitive environment.

title: 1st Place – Ideathon at TECHBETA 2026, St. Xavier’s Catholic College of Engineering
desc: Secured 1st place in the Ideathon at TECHBETA 2026, a National Level Technical Symposium hosted by St. Xavier’s Catholic College of Engineering. Presented ResQFlow, an AI-powered food rescue ecosystem designed to reduce food waste through surplus prediction, intelligent donor-to-NGO matching, volunteer route optimization, and perishability-aware logistics using advanced AI and optimization techniques.
